title: 5 Offbeat Hidden Gems in Meghalaya You Haven't Heard Of
summary: Ditch the crowds and explore these secret locations, pristine lakes, and untouched villages in Meghalaya.
content: While major sights draw crowds, the true magic of Meghalaya lies in its off-the-beaten-path locations. In this guide, we take you off the tourist grid to explore serene forests, secret waterfalls, and ancient local temples. We reveal spots like Balpakram National Park and Jakrem Hot Springs that have preserved their raw natural beauty and tribal culture, offering perfect retreats for solo backpackers and nature lovers.
